description: Fork of exp489-492 (MatmulMultiHeadLut, AdamW=unembedder, bs=16). gate_mode=softmax: g=softmax(ts/T_sel) over K rows, out = g @ W. The principled normalized exp-hamming kernel (softmax(ts/T)[k] ~ exp(-2*h_k/T_sel)) -- the thing the unit/signed/LN/hamming gates were badly reinventing. Memory-light (no int64), clean @torch.compile einsum path. Tests if this reproduces exp444's soft-mixture win (1.4821, beats exp475 hard 1.4962 by ~14mb) AND whether the compiled matmul path is FASTER than exp444's slow SoftMultiHeadLut (~5x wallclock). vs exp475 1.4962.
